pretreatment: Cryogenic milling of iron oxalate powder, followed by thermal decomposition in a fluidized bed reactor (FBR) to produce iron nanoparticles
surface_functionalization: Aluminum nitride (AlN) interlayer deposited via atomic layer deposition (ALD) to passivate the iron core particles from oxidation during TiO2 ALD
evidence: The iron nanoparticles were produced by thermal decomposition of cryogenically milled iron oxalate powders. ... To avoid oxidation, the core iron particles were precoated with an oxygen-free film, specifically aluminum nitride.
